mappings.reasoning: Single-line free-text input matches a single-line textbox.
Free text over several lines maps to a multi-line textbox.
Whole-number input with optional bounds/units is a whole-number field.
Numbers with a fractional part belong in a decimal-number field.
Calendar date without time corresponds to a Date field.
Time of day without date corresponds to a Time field.
A combined date and time belongs in a Date/Time field.
An explicit two-state yes/no control matches a Yes/No toggle.
A collapsed one-of list is a dropdown.
Zero-or-more selections from a coded list are a checklist of boxes.
Exactly one choice with all options visible uses radio buttons.
A single on/off tick corresponds to a single checkbox.
Values derived by formula map to a calculated field.

notes: This library distinguishes a single Checkbox (boolean tick) from a Yes/No Toggle (also boolean); use Checkbox for a single tick and Yes/No Toggle for generic yes/no.
Single-select has two distinct widgets: Dropdown (collapsed one-of) and Radio Buttons (always visible one-of). Pick based on UI behavior requirements.
Multi-select is 'Check List' (a list of checkboxes). Do not confuse it with the singular 'Checkbox'.
Numbers are split into Number (Whole) vs Number (Decimal); choose carefully to avoid later migrations.
Date, Time, and Date/Time are separate elements; avoid using Date or Time where Date/Time is required.
